K-Pop Shark Heroes
programme.desc: Comedian Ken Jeong and Grammy-nominated singer Rei Ami team up with shark experts to reveal sharks' superpowers through K-Pop.

programme.title: Air Jaws: Red, White and Breach
programme.desc: Reports and video evidence of flying great whites off the California coast sparks a mission to capture the new phenomena on film and determine if Air Jaws has taken flight in America.

programme.title: Invasion of the Mega Sharks
programme.desc: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white believed to be one of the largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm
programme.desc: In the summer of 2024, dozens of cameras captured a rare outbreak of shark attacks along America's Gulf Coast; told exclusively through first-hand accounts of victims and eyewitnesses, all these perspectives are seen unfolding in real time.

programme.title: Great White Double Trouble
programme.desc: Australia is in the midst of a rising wave of shark attacks, with great whites leading the way, and scientists have just discovered that Aussies are facing not one population of great whites, but two; researchers want to know who rules the waters.

programme.title: Sharktopia
programme.desc: In Indonesia's Raja Ampat Islands, a team of researchers hunts for one of the region's last living leopard sharks; they venture deeper into the unknown and their journey brings them face to face with some of the weirdest and wildest sharks on Earth.

programme.title: Dawn of the Monster Mako
programme.desc: A 14-foot giant mako shark is spotted in the waters of Portugal's Azores region; underwater cinematographer Joe Romeiro and his wife, marine biologist Lauren, search the teeming depths around the ancient islands to capture the beast on film.

programme.title: Sharks vs. Dolphins: Face Off
programme.desc: Dr. Mike Heithaus and his team provide research on the hostile and dangerous relationship between two masters of the sea: sharks and dolphins.

programme.title: Sydney Harbor Shark Invasion
programme.desc: Three recent bull shark encounters in the heart of Sydney Harbor leave the city on edge; shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder returns to the exact location where a bull shark nearly took his life to determine the cause for the spike in attacks.

programme.title: Monster Hammerheads: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: Dr. Tristan Guttridge believes hammerhead sharks can reach monster sizes by hunting other sharks; they try to prove it by getting tissue samples from some of these large sharks.

programme.title: Jaws Awakens
programme.desc: Shark expert Chris Fallows joins Jeff Kurr and Dickie Chivell to search for the largest male great white shark in the world; Chris, Jeff and Dickie explore the waters of New Zealand trying to find a nearly 20-foot long, two-ton shark named Fred.

programme.title: Jaws Awakens: Phred vs. Slash
programme.desc: Two of the largest sharks in existence have been recently roaming New Zealand waters; nobody knows which one is the largest.

programme.title: Great White Fight Club
programme.desc: A team of experts ventures into the treacherous waters of New Zealand to provide groundbreaking evidence that female white sharks unequivocally dominate the ocean, reigning as the ultimate controllers of its fierce battlegrounds.

programme.title: K-Pop Shark Heroes
